content.text: Launching the Gauntlet: parallel bar recon + orchestrator that will fan out builder/critic pairs and keep iterating.

input.prompt:
You are the BAR RECONNAISSANCE agent for a Gauntlet Loop redesigning dhruv2mars.com.

## Mission
Visit and deeply analyze these quality-bar personal sites. Produce judgeable evidence (screenshots + written criteria) so builders/critics can compare against them.

Bar sites (visit ALL):
1. https://eftakher.me
2. https://ericsin.com
3. https://dai.is-a.dev
4. https://pablostanley.com
5. https://pham.codes
6. https://loganliffick.com
7. https://evilrabbit.com

Also visit current site: https://dhruv2mars.com (baseline to beat).

## Workspace
Repo: /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio
Write ALL outputs under: /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/gauntlet/bar/
Create directories as needed.

## Required deliverables
1. `gauntlet/bar/INDEX.md` — one-row summary per site (what they nail, signature craft, what NOT to copy blindly)
2. Per site folder `gauntlet/bar/<slug>/`:
   - `notes.md` — typography, color, layout rhythm, motion, nav pattern, hero treatment, content hierarchy, mobile behavior
   - Desktop + mobile screenshots of first viewport and key scroll sections (save PNGs in that folder)
3. `gauntlet/bar/WIN_CRITERIA.md` — extract 8–15 concrete, judgeable win criteria for a personal portfolio that must beat this bar (e.g. "first viewport brand dominance", "editorial type hierarchy", "motion restraint with presence", etc.). Make them A/B-testable.
4. `gauntlet/bar/ANTI_PATTERNS.md` — what these sites avoid (generic AI purple, card grids in hero, clutter, weak branding, etc.)

## Tools
- Use cursor-ide-browser MCP (browser_navigate, browser_lock, browser_snapshot, browser_take_screenshot, browser_scroll). GetMcpTools first for schemas.
- Prefer real screenshots over guesses. Capture desktop (~1440) and mobile (~390) where possible.
- Use bun if scripting needed.

## Constraints
- Do NOT edit the app frontend source. Bar evidence only.
- Do NOT invent criteria you didn't observe.
- Own judgment: distill principles, don't clone any one site.

## Done when
All 7 bars + current site have notes + screenshots, INDEX + WIN_CRITERIA + ANTI_PATTERNS exist, and you return a short summary of the strongest craft signals and the hardest gaps for dhruv2mars.com.

You are the GAUNTLET LOOP ORCHESTRATOR for a full from-scratch frontend redesign of dhruv2mars.com.

## Goal
Redo the whole dhruv2mars.com frontend from scratch until it wins against the bar—or until the user stops.

Bar: eftakher.me, ericsin.com, dai.is-a.dev, pablostanley.com, pham.codes, loganliffick.com, evilrabbit.com.

## Hard process rules (non-negotiable)
1. **Own approach** — you choose architecture, visual direction, and decomposition. Do not prescribe a clone of any bar site. Read CONTEXT.md + docs/adr/ for domain language, but the visual system may be reinvented.
2. **Smallest independently improvable, judgeable pieces** — split the goal into the smallest pieces that can each be built and judged in isolation (e.g. type system, color/atmosphere, first-viewport/home composition, nav chrome, projects list craft, blog index/article typography, motion language, mobile pass, etc.). Write the piece list in workbench.md.
3. **For each important piece: fan out fresh-context BUILDER + separate CRITIC** — maximize parallelism via Task tool subagents (`run_in_background: true` when Multitask/parallel). Builder and critic MUST be separate agents with fresh context (do not reuse the same agent for both roles on the same piece).
4. **Critics MUST shell out to Codex** using model `gpt-5.6-luna` at **high** reasoning. Example pattern:
   ```bash
   codex exec -m gpt-5.6-luna -c 'model_reasoning_effort="high"' -s danger-full-access -C /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio --skip-git-repo-check "$(cat <<'EOF'
   You are a blind design critic. Inspect REAL local output (running site / screenshots). Compare against bar sites. Blind A/B when possible (label A/B without saying which is ours). Return ONLY: winner, biggest remaining gap, next build instruction.
   ...
   EOF
   )"
   ```
   Adjust flags if needed after `codex exec --help`. Persist critic transcripts under `gauntlet/critics/`.
5. Critics must **inspect real output** (dev server screenshots / browser), compare **directly against bar**, use **blind A/B when possible**, and return the **biggest remaining gap**.
6. **Iterate** piece-by-piece until our output wins that piece or user stops. After critic returns a gap, spawn a new builder round for that piece, then a new critic.
7. Use **as many subagents as possible**. Prefer parallel piece streams when independent. You may use Cursor Task tool extensively.
8. Maintain live progress in `gauntlet/workbench.md` (scoreboard, piece status, evidence links, biggest gaps, next moves).
9. **Verify final site end-to-end** (Home, Blog, Projects, theme toggle, mobile+desktop, build/typecheck) before declaring any overall win.

## Workspace & git
- Repo: `/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio`
- Prefer bun for all package scripts.
- Branch per task: create/use `feat/gauntlet-frontend-redesign` from latest main. Call SetActiveBranch when on the branch.
- Small commits with `feat:` / `fix:` / `test:` when a piece round lands something verifiable. Do NOT push or open PR unless asked.
- Do not commit secrets.

## Skills to use when relevant
Read and follow when applicable:
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/.claude/skills/impeccable/SKILL.md`
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/.claude/skills/emil-design-eng/SKILL.md`
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/.claude/skills/animation-vocabulary/SKILL.md`
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/.claude/skills/find-animation-opportunities/SKILL.md`
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/.claude/skills/web-design-guidelines/SKILL.md`
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/.claude/skills/nextjs/SKILL.md`
- Frontend design user rules: brand-first first viewport, expressive fonts (not Inter/Roboto/Arial/system), atmospheric backgrounds, full-bleed hero where appropriate, no cards in hero, one job per section, 2–3 intentional motions, avoid purple-on-white / cream+terracotta / broadsheet clichés, no emoji decoration.

## Domain
Read `/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/CONTEXT.md` and `AGENTS.md`. Preserve product meaning (Home / Blog / Projects, AI Activity heatmap concept, editorial personal brand) unless a redesign decision consciously supersedes presentation while keeping routes/content working.

## Parallel inputs
A separate BAR RECON agent is writing to `gauntlet/bar/`. Poll/consume:
- `gauntlet/bar/WIN_CRITERIA.md`
- `gauntlet/bar/INDEX.md`
- screenshots under `gauntlet/bar/*/`
If bar recon is not ready yet: start decomposition + scaffolding + branch setup, then incorporate criteria as soon as they land. You may also do light bar visits yourself if blocked.

## Suggested first actions (you may adapt)
1. Create `gauntlet/workbench.md` with north star, piece backlog, scoreboard.
2. Create branch `feat/gauntlet-frontend-redesign`.
3. Inspect current app structure (app router, components, styles).
4. Define piece list (smallest judgeable units) and mark first 3–5 as Round 1.
5. Fan out Round 1 builders in parallel for independent pieces; after each builder finishes, fan out a Codex-backed critic.
6. Update workbench after every round.
7. Keep looping.

## Builder agent brief (pass to builders)
- Fresh context; implement only their assigned piece.
- Run/dev-server as needed; produce screenshots under `gauntlet/pieces/<piece>/rN/`.
- Leave evidence paths for the critic.
- Prefer cohesive craft over feature sprawl.

## Critic agent brief (pass to critics)
- MUST shell to Codex `gpt-5.6-luna` high reasoning (not just self-review).
- Blind A/B: show our screenshot vs bar screenshot without revealing which is ours when possible.
- Output schema: `{ piece, round, winner: us|bar|tie, biggest_gap, next_build_instruction, evidence_paths[] }`
- Write result to `gauntlet/critics/<piece>-rN.md`

## Done definition for a piece
Critic (via Codex) declares **us** wins vs bar on that piece's criteria, with evidence.

## Overall done
Most critical pieces win, site E2E verified (routes, a11y basics, responsive, `bun` typecheck/build), workbench reflects wins, and you report remaining gaps honestly.

## Return to parent when
- Round 1 complete (builders+critics for initial pieces) with workbench updated, OR
- Blocked needing user input, OR
- Overall win / ready for human review.

Include: piece statuses, Codex critic verdicts, biggest remaining gaps, URLs/paths to screenshots, next planned rounds.

Maximize subagent fan-out. Do not stop after planning—build and judge real output.
